rows.title: Rodeohead
notes: “Holiday Sidewinder with her song called Rodeo Head, and I thought it's a great song. Why not? Here it is.”
2026 single on Venus Beach Records by Sydney-born Holiday Sidewinder, co-written with Alex Cameron and Fred Macpherson; 'Rodeo Head' is a phonetic ASR match for 'Rodeohead'.
“loved working-class musos and jeans in Japan”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
